entries.name: Acetaminophen (paracetamol)
entries.purpose: Fever reducer and mild-to-moderate pain reliever.
entries.side_effects: Liver injury in overdose or with regular alcohol use; rare serious skin reactions.
entries.interactions: Warfarin effect may increase with regular use; many combination products already contain it — total daily amount counts.

citations.source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, DailyMed: acetaminophen drug label.

entries.name: Ibuprofen
entries.purpose: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory for pain, fever and inflammation.
entries.side_effects: Stomach pain, heartburn, fluid retention; cardiovascular and gastrointestinal risk rises with dose and duration; kidney injury in dehydration.
entries.interactions: Avoid combining with other NSAIDs; caution with blood-pressure medicines, lithium and anticoagulants.

citations.source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, DailyMed: ibuprofen drug label.

entries.name: Loratadine
entries.side_effects: Usually well tolerated; occasional headache, dry mouth or drowsiness.
entries.interactions: Few known interactions; check against the mission formulary before combining sedating medicines.

citations.source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, DailyMed: loratadine drug label.
